expected_findings.description: With device ID bucketing and a person condition below 100%, turning experience continuity on or off reads as BUCKETING_CHANGED and RAISES, though the flag service does not read continuity under device ID bucketing; count continuity only for distinct_id.

aggregation is also None when conditions mix person and group aggregation, so a caller that follows the field's comment counts only persons; return the group types of the conditions that serve somebody, or drop the field until it is needed.
